observations: Starting from the page, Tab reached the brand link, Explore navigation button, then the responsive account opener.
Enter opened login and placed initial focus in Email.
Tab order moved Email → Password → Login → Create account → Close → Email; Shift+Tab from Email moved to Close.
Escape closed the login dialog and restored focus to the responsive account opener.

Keyboard activation of Create account exposed Name, Email, Password, and Create account controls; focus indication remained visible on the return-to-login switch, and Escape restored focus to the opener.
limitations: This observation covers responsive-width keyboard operation, not the full A11Y-03 workflow.
It does not establish screen-reader speech, background pointer inertness, field error announcements, actual 320 CSS px/200%/400% zoom behavior, or physical-device touch.
